about: WP-037 eval set: retrieval across English, Arabic and Urdu, and short answers in each language. Original text written for SupportX.

documents.vpn: The VPN disconnects every hour. Reconnect from the tray icon; if it keeps dropping, reinstall the VPN client and check the office Wi-Fi.
documents.password: To reset your password, open the portal, choose Forgot password and follow the link sent to your work e-mail.
documents.printer: The printer on floor 3 shows a paper jam. Open tray 2, remove the stuck sheet and restart the printer.
documents.toner: When a printer reports low toner, request a new cartridge through the catalog item Printer supplies.
documents.outlook: Outlook keeps asking for the password: remove the saved credential in Credential Manager and sign in again.
documents.laptop: A new laptop is requested through the catalog item New laptop; your manager approves it before it is ordered.
documents.wifi: The guest Wi-Fi password changes every Monday and is shown on the reception screen.
documents.mfa: Set up two-step sign-in with the authenticator app: scan the QR code on My profile and enter the six-digit code.
documents.teams: If Teams calls have no sound, check the selected microphone and speaker in Teams settings under Devices.
documents.storage: Your mailbox is full: archive old e-mail or empty Deleted Items to free space.

answers.prompt: Summarise this incident in one sentence: The user reports the VPN disconnects every hour since Monday; reinstalling did not help.

اس واقعے کا خلاصہ اردو میں ایک جملے میں لکھیں: صارف بتاتا ہے کہ پیر سے وی پی این ہر گھنٹے منقطع ہو جاتا ہے، دوبارہ انسٹال کرنے سے فائدہ نہیں ہوا۔
